subject: Exclusive Summer Sale: 30% Off All Swimwear!
body: Dear valued customers, Dive into savings this summer with our exclusive sale on all swimwear! Whether you're lounging by the pool or hitting the beach, enjoy 30% off on our latest collection of swimsuits, cover-ups, and accessories. Don't miss out on this limited-time offer to refresh your summer wardrobe. Shop now online or visit our store to make a splash with style!
